moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships are currently underway in Birmingham, running until August 16th, marking the first time the UK has hosted this prestigious event.

angles.name: Live Action Update
angles.copy: Athletics fever is gripping Birmingham! The European Championships are live all week, with Team GB pushing for medals. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Birmingham Buzz
angles.copy: Birmingham is buzzing as the European Athletics Championships continue! Incredible scenes and world-class talent on display until Sunday. Catch the highlights!

moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, takes place this Saturday, August 15th, at Wembley Stadium.

angles.name: Wembley Showdown
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is ready for the FA Community Shield this Saturday! A huge London day for football fans – who are you supporting?

angles.name: Stay Cool
angles.copy: Another warm one across the UK today! Remember to stay hydrated as we continue on track for a potentially record-breaking summer.
